name: What are the advantages of buying a pre-construction home?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of buying a pre-construction home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Advantages of buying pre-construction include getting a brand-new home with modern designs and the opportunity to choose finishes and upgrades, allowing for significant personalization. New homes also often come with builder warranties, providing peace of mind regarding potential issues. A practical tradeoff is that while you can customize, the exact timeline for completion can be subject to change, requiring flexibility. Your agent can guide you through the selection process and help manage expectations regarding builder timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include a new home, customization options, and builder warranties, though completion timelines can vary.
